create_EnergyFunction: create an EnergyFunction module with a manifold, dimension, and size for Poincaré embeddings
run_EnergyFunction_forward: run the EnergyFunction forward pass on input indices to compute energy between subject and object embeddings
use_EnergyFunction_optim_params: use the EnergyFunction optim_params method to get manifold-aware optimizer parameters with retraction and transport
create_DistanceEnergyFunction: create a DistanceEnergyFunction that computes energy as manifold distance between subject and object embeddings
create_EntailmentConeEnergyFunction: create an EntailmentConeEnergyFunction with a margin for modeling entailment relations using cone geometry
